# CrowdChange Docs (offline mirror)

> Offline Markdown mirror of CrowdChange's documentation sites: the CrowdChange Help Center (https://ch.crowdchange.help/cnak), the CrowdChange Admin Help Center (https://chadmin.crowdchange.help/ct), which cover using the platform UI as a charity or as an admin, and the API & developer docs (https://apidoc.crowdchange.dev): REST endpoints, webhooks, widgets and analytics integrations. Built as reference material for a CrowdChange-to-CRM integration. Retrieved 2026-10-14.

Navigation: docs/help-center/INDEX.md, docs/chadmin/INDEX.md, docs/api/INDEX.md (trees, plus an endpoint table for the API), docs/TAGS.md (topics across all). Each collection has a manifest.json with every page's metadata. Every page starts with YAML front matter.
